verdict.rationale: Salesmate is a CRM, so detecting and merging duplicate contacts or companies is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack only says Salesmate manages contacts and companies in one place; nothing mentions duplicate detection or merging. Managing records generally, or autonomous AI record updates, is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can detect duplicate contacts or companies and merge them without losing data
